description:
HushPinterest 0.0.6 has 26 patches for Pinterest 14.38.0. It's built on Morphe patcher 1.15.1, so it needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. New this time are Download board, Long-press download and Hide survey prompts, and Morphe Manager now selects every patch but Spoof signature for Google sign-in by default, with the newly selected ones' switches starting off.

This is the first release without Pinterest 14.25.0. On Android 9, keep HushPinterest 0.0.5 with Pinterest 14.25.0.

## What's new

- HushPinterest now patches Pinterest 14.38.0 only, which needs Android 10 or newer. On Android 9, keep HushPinterest 0.0.5 with Pinterest 14.25.0.
- Morphe Manager's default selection now holds every patch but Spoof signature for Google sign-in, so you don't need Expert mode to find a feature. The 16 patches that joined it start with their switches off, so a build patched with the defaults acts like Pinterest until you turn one on in HushPinterest settings. Hide ads, Disable analytics, Strip link tracking and Hide advertising ID still start on.
- Hide AI-labeled pins now starts off. If you updated without ever changing it, it's off now, so turn it back on from the Feed page of HushPinterest settings if you want it.
- In Expert mode, Disable update nag sits under Updates and the two button patches under Navigation, so the Interface group is shorter to read.
- Each patch's description in Morphe Manager now says which page of HushPinterest settings holds its switch, and whether that switch starts on or off.
- Patch descriptions in Morphe Manager are rewritten in plain English. Each one says what the patch changes, why you might want it, and ends with where its switch is and whether it starts on or off.
- Setting rows in HushPinterest settings are reworded in plain English, with restart reminders and clearer notes on when a change shows. Translations for German, Spanish, Indonesian, Brazilian Portuguese and Turkish are updated to match.
- Download, setup guide, import and update-check messages are plainer and say what to do next. Translations are updated to match.
- New Download board patch. It adds Download board to a board's menu, which saves every pin Pinterest has loaded for that board (up to 500) the same way Download pins does. Pins already in Download history are skipped, and when it's done you see how many were saved, skipped or unsupported, with a reminder that only loaded pins are included. So scroll to the end of a board first if you want all of it. Download pins has to be on too. The switch starts off on the Pin actions page, and with it off or HushPinterest paused, the board menu is Pinterest's own. Nothing new is asked of Pinterest apart from the media downloads themselves.
- New Long-press download patch. Hold a pin in a grid and Pinterest's round menu gets a Download button after its own buttons. Slide onto it and let go, and the pin saves the same way Download pin in the pin menu saves it, so it shows up in Download history too. Download pins has to be on as well. The switch starts off on the Pin actions page, and with it off or HushPinterest paused, the menu is Pinterest's own. Boards and anything else you hold keep Pinterest's buttons.
- New Hide survey prompts patch. Pinterest sometimes opens with a "Got a minute? Take a quick survey" invite. With the switch on, HushPinterest turns it down before it shows, the same way tapping Maybe later does, so Pinterest marks that survey dismissed and doesn't queue it again on the next launch. Advertiser sponsored polls, which Pinterest opens as their own pop-up rather than in the feed, are skipped too. The switch starts off on the Interface page, and with it off or HushPinterest paused, Pinterest shows its invites and polls as before. An invite that's already on screen stays until you close it.

## Behind the scenes

- The heavy desktop jobs now wait for a slot in the machine's build queue when `BUILD_QUEUE_SCRIPT` names one: CLI patch runs, split bundle merges, the resource table check, the dex and host reference checks and fingerprint ranking. They show up in the queue's status and no longer start beside two Gradle builds. A release receipt asks for release priority. The push hook reads `BUILD_QUEUE_SCRIPT` from the user environment too, and without a build wrapper its Gradle run waits for a slot as well.
- The patch tests that open the Pinterest APKs now run in their own Gradle task, `:patches:fixtureTest`, and `:patches:test` refuses any test that tries to read one. Each APK is unzipped once per run instead of once per test, and its decoded manifest is kept the same way. The push check runs the fixture task after the quick checks, and the task fails when it runs no tests, or when it skips one while the fixtures are required.
- Updated four runtime checks to match the current setup, link and download messages.
- A release now ends with `scripts/verify-published-index.ps1`. It asks GitHub for the latest release and for the patches-bundle.json that main serves, and fails when they disagree, naming any index commit that never got pushed. For most of October 7, v0.0.5 was out while the index still said 0.0.4, so Morphe Manager didn't offer the update to anyone on 0.0.4. It came up in #3.
- A patch test now fails when the extension carries a class from outside its own package, apart from the three Kotlin helpers it has always kept. The patcher lays such a class over Pinterest's own copy, and Download board's lookup of Kotlin's Unit had briefly pulled one in.
- Added [measured factory network and background activity](docs/pinterest-14.38.0-runtime.md), with reusable comparison data, CPU and media timers, memory samples and scheduled-worker records. Kept physical battery drain explicitly unmeasured until an unplugged phone run is available.
- Added a [signed-in factory audit](docs/pinterest-14.38.0-audit.md) with ad-delivery traces, privacy boundaries, all 23 patch mappings, native settings, screenshots and specific work to investigate next. Clarified that analytics filtering covers selected paths.
- Mapped the factory Pinterest 14.38.0 APK and first-run screen, with patch anchors for future updates.

## Update from 0.0.5

1. Morphe Manager offers 0.0.6 from the HushPinterest patch source. Patch Pinterest 14.38.0 and install it over your current Pinterest. Your sign-in and switches stay, as long as Morphe Manager signs it with the same key as before.
2. Download board, Long-press download and Hide survey prompts are new and selected by default, with their switches off. Download board and Long-press download are on the Pin actions page of HushPinterest settings and need Download pins on too. Hide survey prompts is on the Interface page.
3. Hide AI-labeled pins now starts off. If you never changed it, turn it back on from the Feed page if you want it.
4. Still on Pinterest 14.25.0 because your phone runs Android 9? Stay on 0.0.5, since this release doesn't patch 14.25.0.

## New install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.34.0 or newer.
2. Add HushPinterest as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushPinterest
3. Download Pinterest **14.38.0**, version code **14388010**, as the universal APK, and patch it. It needs Android 10 or newer.
4. Uninstall the stock Pinterest first, since Android won't put one over the other. Save anything you keep only on the phone before you do. Your boards and pins come back when you sign in.
5. Sign in with your email and a Pinterest password. If you joined through Google or Facebook, tap **Forgot your password?** on Pinterest's login page to set one first.
6. Right after your first patch, export Morphe Manager's signing key (Settings, then System, then Import & export, then Signing key) and keep it somewhere private. Updates only install over a Pinterest signed with that same key.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#install). `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed with the HushPinterest release key, fingerprint `FCE5 ECE3 182A 647B 3AF2  C5ED 2DC3 5E8D 5C00 E8A6`. [How to check a download](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#verify-a-release-download).

## Validation

All 186 patch tests and 705 extension tests passed on this commit, none skipped. The bundle attached here was patched onto a real Pinterest 14.38.0 APK with Morphe's desktop patcher, and all 26 patches applied without forcing. `release-receipt-0.0.6.json` records that result, the APK's hash and what patching changed in the app's manifest.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Pinterest from sending usage reports, crash reports and ad-tracking data to outside companies, and turns off Google's analytics inside the app. Good if you'd rather share less. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable update nag
patches.description: Stops Pinterest's pop-ups asking you to update from the Play Store. You can still update Pinterest yourself. Good if the reminders get annoying. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > More settings > Updates.

patches.name: Download board
patches.description: Adds Download board to a board's menu. It saves every pin Pinterest has loaded for that board and skips ones already in Download history, so you can keep a board without picking pins one at a time. Needs Download pins on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches.name: Download pins
patches.description: Adds downloads for a pin, or for several pins you select in a grid. Saves the original image or the highest-quality video Pinterest supplies to your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches.name: Filter pin menu
patches.description: Lets you hide Add to collage, Remix collage, Search image and Promote pin in a pin's menu, each with its own switch. Download, share and copy link stay. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes promoted pins from your home feed, search, related pins and boards, and hides panels that only hold ads. Good for a cleaner feed. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide advertising ID
patches.description: Pinterest sees an empty advertising ID with ad tracking limited, the same as if you deleted your ad ID in Android. Good for keeping ads from following you. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide AI-labeled pins
patches.description: Removes pins that Pinterest labels as made or changed with AI from your home feed, search, related pins and boards. AI images without the label still show. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide comments
patches.description: Collapses the comments and comment previews under pins. It doesn't change who can comment on your pins. Good for a quieter pin page. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide header buttons
patches.description: Hides the small icon buttons at the end of the top bar. Back buttons, text buttons and account controls stay. Good for a cleaner top bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches.description: Lets you hide the Create, Notifications and Search buttons in the bottom bar, each with its own switch. Home and Profile stay. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide save toasts
patches.description: Stops the pop-up Pinterest shows after you save a pin, such as the Saved to your board message or a suggestion to follow the creator. The pin is still saved. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide search history
patches.description: Hides your recent searches on the search screen of this phone. It doesn't delete your account's search history. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide shopping and product pins
patches.description: Hides shoppable pins, shopping stories and featured boards. Good if you want to browse ideas, not products. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide survey prompts
patches.description: Turns down Pinterest's "Got a minute?" survey invite before it pops up, the same way tapping Maybe later does, so the same survey doesn't come back. Advertiser sponsored polls don't pop up either. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Hide topic suggestions
patches.description: Hides the Ideas you might love row of topic bubbles under pins, without leaving a gap. Comments and related pins stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: HushPinterest settings
patches.description: Adds a HushPinterest page to Pinterest where you turn features on or off, pause HushPinterest, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it by long-pressing the Pinterest icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Long-press download
patches.description: Adds a Download button to the round menu you get when you long-press a pin in a grid, so you can save a pin without opening it. Slide onto the button and let go. Needs Download pins on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches.name: No screenshot share menu
patches.description: Stops Pinterest from popping up sharing suggestions after you take a screenshot. Screenshots still work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Open links in your browser
patches.description: Opens a pin's Visit link and profile websites in your web browser. Pinterest links and sign-in work as before. Good if you prefer your own browser. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > More settings > Links.

patches.name: Original-quality images
patches.description: Loads the original image for each pin and in collages, instead of the large size. Pictures look sharper but use more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Quiet email reminders
patches.description: Dismisses the optional reminder to confirm your email. Account checks and sign-in still work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches.name: Remove ad tracking permissions
patches.description: Removes Google's advertising ID permission and Android's Privacy Sandbox ad services from Pinterest, so it can't use them. Google Play services then answers with zeros. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Spoof signature for Google sign-in
patches.description: Helps Google sign-in work in the patched app by naming Pinterest's original signature. It only helps with microG-RE or the XSpoofSignatures module. Email sign-in doesn't need it. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Strip link tracking
patches.description: Removes tracking tags from links you copy or share from Pinterest. The link still goes to the same place, and short pin.it links stay as they are. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches.name: System share sheet
patches.description: Uses Android's own share menu when you share a pin link. Screenshot and download actions work as before. Good if you want your usual share targets. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.
